name: Oxygen tank farm
brief: MK-011 Oxygen tank farm. Round 2, matched to the pick: three tall white capsule tanks on a steel skid, each with a blue band, a warm frost window down its side and a valve on top, joined by a manifold with valve wheels and two big pressure dials at the foot. Diegetic: the dials and the glow level in the windows say how much air the base has.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
